Below, we detail our latest product and ecosystem updates, third-quarter financial performance and outlook for the remainder of 2026.

Connected Devices revenue increased 16% to $472 million, with growth moderating sequentially due to normal third-quarter seasonality and the timing of an approximately $30 million Federal Dedrone deployment we had expected to recognize during the quarter.
Growth would have been stronger absent the timing of an approximately $30 million Federal Dedrone deployment we had expected to recognize during the quarter.

• Revenue: We expect revenue of $990 million to $1.01 billion.
• Adjusted EBITDA: We expect Adjusted EBITDA of $245 million to $250 million.

◦ We provide Adjusted EBITDA margin guidance, rather than net income margin guidance, due to the inherent difficulty of forecasting certain types of expenses and gains such as stock-based compensation, income tax expenses and gains or losses on marketable s ecurities and strategic investments, which affect net income but not Adjusted EBITDA.
• Revenue: Our fourth-quarter revenue guidance implies full-year 2026 revenue of approximately $3.61 billion to $3.63 billion, representing approximately 30% annual growth.

The reduction from our prior guidance of 32% to 34% annual growth reflects the exclusion of three Federal Dedrone deployments totaling approximately $130 million that were contemplated in our prior expectations.

Had the three Federal Dedrone deployments remained on pace for 2026, our full-year growth outlook would be nearly 500 basis points higher than our current guidance and approximately 200 basis points above the midpoint of our prior guidance.
• Adjusted EBITDA: Our fourth-quarter Adjusted EBITDA guidance implies full-year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA of $924 million to $929 million.

• Free cash flow: We expect full-year 2026 free cash flow of $350 million to $400 million, modestly below our prior target of $450 million due to our accelerated inventory investment to strengthen product availability and supply chain resilience.
In aggregate, our inventory strategy is expected to utilize $225 million in cash for the full year.

Excluding this strategic inventory investment, which we expect to moderate after the first quarter of 2027, free cash flow conversion on Adjusted EBITDA would be on track to exceed our long-term target of 60%.
• Stock-based compensation: We expect stock-based compensation expense of approximately $570 million to $600 million, a decrease from $590 million to $620 million previously.
• CapEx: We expect 2026 CapEx to be in the range of $130 million to $150 million, a decrease from $160 million to $190 million.
◦ Our 2026 capital expenditure plans include long-term R&D investment projects, continued capacity expansion, global facility build-outs and new product development costs.
